messages:
Priya (eng-platform): hey team — proposal: add a tiny optional hint field in SDKs called `x-rd-route-pref` / SDK param `route_preference` with enum values `latency|cost|balanced`. purely a hint for routing telemetry and console breakdowns, no quota impact. opt-in sampling. thoughts?

Sam (devex): nice. agree opt-in. we should be explicit about privacy and sampling. how do we plan to sample and surface it in console?

Carlos (sdk-python): sounds reasonable. implementation q: header vs body? if header, proxies might drop it. i propose SDK exposes `route_preference='latency'` param and sets header `x-rd-route-pref: latency` when provided. example: 
```py
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=..., route_preference='latency')
client.generate("...")
```
Fallback: don't send header when None.

Jia (sdk-ts): we can mirror that in TS. agree enum-only. small caution: this MUST be a hint only — server should not use it to alter billing or quota enforcement. also we should have an env var or client option to disable emitting the hint entirely.

Priya (eng-platform): server will treat it as a hint and ignore it for billing and quota. Console will ingests sampled hint tags and show aggregated breakdowns. sampling default: start at 0.5% of traffic with a feature flag to increase. we can also allow tenant-level opt-in.

Marta (console): useful. UX note: don't add another always-on card. propose a toggle in the per-route dashboard: "Show route preference breakdown" which opens a small stacked sparkline and legend. also map unknown/legacy values into an "unknown" bucket.

Carlos (sdk-python): implementation note: sanitize values, accept only the enum. unit tests should ensure header not set for invalid values. backcompat: servers should ignore unknown values gracefully.

Priya (eng-platform): action items: 1) eng-platform implement server-side accept/ignore semantics + sampling hook. 2) devex draft opt-in messaging + privacy blurb. 3) SDKs add a tiny param + env var to disable default opt-in. 4) console add feature flag + dashboard toggle and unknown bucket. timeline?

Jia (sdk-ts): can we soft-launch to canary next week? I can open a TS PR by Thu.

Carlos (sdk-python): i'll aim for a python PR by Fri, include unit tests and a small integration test with a local proxy to verify header emission.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: feature/route-pref-api -> canary at 2024-11-04T22:00Z by @ci-bot :rocket:

Sam (devex): :thumbsup: i'll put together a short changelog blurb and the privacy section (explicit about no PII, sample rate, opt-out).

Priya (eng-platform): thanks all. i'll open the tracking GH issue and link PRs. cc @Marta for UX mocks.
